items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 73:1
items.html: For that drop of MAD is the drop of the coupling of AB that brings down the bottom Hey from Einayim and cancels the Parsaot, which comes from Moach Stimaah, which is AB and the Hochma of AA, as is known. And it is known that AB illuminates only down to the Tabur and nothing at all from the Tabur downward. Hence, these MAD are discerned as the phase of the name HaVaYaH missing the bottom Hey, which indicates the phase of illumination of below the Tabur, which is missing in it. (Item 928, item 106)
